prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: modular character identity source board for a classic painted 2D strategy game
Input images: Images 1 and 2 are layout, rendering-quality, lighting, edge, and component-separation references only; generate a new character and do not copy either identity.
Primary request: Create one coherent modular identity board for a young adult frontier wayfarer woman. She has warm medium-brown skin, an oval face, high arched brows, dark almond-shaped eyes, a broad softly rounded nose, a determined neutral expression, and thick nearly-black wavy hair gathered into one low practical braid. Her build is lean, resilient, and slightly narrow-shouldered, visibly distinct from the powerful smith and elderly harborhand references.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat uniform solid #ff00ff chroma-key background.
Style/medium: match the references' high-quality painted raster game-component style, crisp dark contour clusters, controlled warm highlights, believable cloth and skin texture, consistent three-quarter game lighting; source components will later be reduced into classic strategy-game sprites.
Composition/framing: exact 1536x1024 landscape component board with generous empty gaps. Top row: three isolated matching head-and-neck views—front, back, and left-facing profile. Middle row: isolated bare left arm, close-fitting neutral dark undershirt torso front, torso back, torso left profile, isolated bare right arm. Bottom row: close-fitting neutral dark trouser-and-boot legs front, rear legs, and left-profile legs. Keep every component complete, uncropped, non-overlapping, and large enough for clean extraction.
Identity invariants: same woman, face, skin tone, hairline, low braid, proportions, body build, and lighting in every view. Front/back/profile must be genuine authored views, not text labels or duplicate flips.
Constraints: one character identity only; no outer costume, hat, armor, cape, tools, props, jewelry, shadow, floor, texture, gradient, border, labels, text, or watermark. Background must be one exact flat color with no lighting variation. Do not use #ff00ff within the character. Crisp silhouettes with at least 24 pixels of magenta padding around every component.
Avoid: full-body posed character, extra heads or limbs, merged components, floating fragments, muscular bodybuilder proportions, photoreal studio cutout, anime style, soft airbrushed edges, modern logos.
